Name: supervised_probe_comparison
Title: Linear vs Nonlinear Probes: What Supervised Classifiers Reveal About Functional Information in Evo2 Embeddings
Experiment: Load cached embeddings from run_0/data/embeddings_evo2_7b.npy and labels from run_0/data/dataset.json. Train and compare three supervised probes on identical stratified train/test splits: (1) Logistic Regression (L2), (2) SVM (RBF kernel), (3) MLP (existing baseline). Report AUROC, accuracy, and F1 for each. Compute the nonlinearity gap (MLP AUROC - LR AUROC) to quantify how much nonlinear structure the embeddings contain. Perform 5-fold cross-validation for all models and report mean ± std AUROC. Generate a ROC curve plot comparing all three models.
